basics.label: Student
basics.summary: I am studying for a B.S. in Computer Science in the Department of Information and Computer Sciences at the University of Hawaii at Manoa. I expect to graduate in Spring, 2028. I am seeking computer science summer internship to strengthen personal competencies, while contributing to the organization’s goals.

work.summary: Graded student assignments and tests for Physics 272 covering calculus-based topics on electricity, magnetism, and geometric optics
Participated in a program with the Pacific Intelligence Innovation Initiative under the Defense Innovation Unit guided by Applied Research Laboratory at the University of Hawaii
highlights: Enhanced a sensor interfacing template generator by making it dynamic with the use of Python
Produced files containing pre-generated code with Cookiecutter and Jinja, which significantly reduced time and effort spent setting up directories and files for sensor drivers
Developed an automatic documentation generator tool with Sphinx and GitHub Actions assisting end users with code usage
Initiated interfacing with an RFM95 radio sensor using Python, employing a communication protocol—Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI)—unfamiliar to the Applied Research Laboratory
